scope: Strictly public released chapters ONLY (Death & Love: 1,350 identity-verified runs across 27 verified models out of 28 queried endpoints / 1,365 public rows). Zero unreleased chapter statistics are included.

excluded_unverified_endpoints.reason: Mistral officially retired mistral-large-2407 on 2025-03-30 (documented HTTP 404 on retirement), yet OpenRouter returned 200 OK with 201,465 / 255,568 (78.8%) reasoning tokens incompatible with 2024 weights. Retained in archaeology_death_love.jsonl with identity_verified=false for auditability and excluded from all reference statistics.

null_jaccard_baseline.method: Cross-model random pairing within non-builtin JS identifier-count quartile buckets across 1,350 verified Death & Love runs (seed=20261120, 4,000 cross-model pairs/bucket).

validation.benchmark_corpus: Contemporary Death frozen human/protocol coding (269 valid statements & paintings; frozen 'neg' = 162/269, frozen visual 'body' = 40/269 [protocols/death/PROTOCOL.md §4], OpenAI bare boat = 14/15).

boat_crossing_lexical_code_indicator.benchmark: 4-model manual audit across n=105 Death runs (openai/gpt-6-astra 30, anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 30, google/gemini-4-argon 30, claude-opus-4-8 bare 15; 30 unambiguous human-coded boat canvases + 1 ambiguous 'barque ou autel de pierre' on Gemini 4 Argon)

per_model_hits.google/gemini-4-argon: 3/30 (2 unambiguous gondola/barge + 1 ambiguous 'barque ou autel'; down from 14/30 before removing 'vessel')

excluded_visual_motif_regexes.decision: Excluded from automated 4-metric diagnostic panel: against the frozen Death visual reading (40/269), candidate lexical/code regexes achieve precision = 0.3721 (54 false positives triggered by negated words such as 'not a corpse' or 'no grave') and Mandarin recall = 0.5556 (models draw geometric silhouettes via numeric coordinates without naming them).
excluded_visual_motif_regexes.candidate_regex_pattern: \b(corpse|cadaver|dead body|shrouded body|shroud|coffin|casket|grave|tomb|burial|funeral|cadavre|corps|linceul|cercueil|tombe)\b|遗体|尸体|尸首|裹尸|棺|坟|墓|\b(skull|skeleton|bone|bones|ribcage|cranium|crâne|squelette|ossements)\b|骷髅|骸骨|白骨|头骨|骨架|\b(hospital|bedside|deathbed|sickbed|mattress|pillow|ward|monitor|lit d'hôpital|chevet|oreiller)\b|病床|床头|枕头|病房|监护
excluded_visual_motif_regexes.candidate_regex_flags: IGNORECASE (applied to camelCase-split title + statement + js_identifiers + js_comments)

render_runtime_error_audit.definition: render_ok=True records that headless Chromium captured a <canvas> element after the 4,000 ms settle window; sketches that threw uncaught JS runtime errors mid-draw or before createCanvas() are retained unedited per protocol.
